templates.title: Qualify inbound leads
templates.author: Chatfuel
aboutParagraphs: A proven qualification system for real estate agencies using WhatsApp and AI.

Respond instantly, qualify every lead, and deliver sales-ready conversations to your team. Built for agencies that want faster response times, higher conversion rates, and a repeatable client service they can sell.

reviews.name: Priya Nair
reviews.text: Most clients asked prices in TikTok comments, but I couldn't reply fast enough. Chatfuel auto-replies with details and invites them to DM. I now book 3–4 new appointments every day straight from TikTok — amazing!

reviews.name: Mariana López
reviews.text: I used to miss half my DMs. Now every single message is answered instantly. The results? My chairs are full, and I don't even touch my phone.
